changelog: FIX: Firestick no longer goes to sleep during playback — WakeLock + FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON are now acquired automatically whenever the player is open. No more waking up to a dead video surface.
FEATURE: Fullscreen button added to player controls bar, next to PiP. Press it to hide the Android navigation bar and status bar for a true cinema-mode immersive experience. Press again to restore.
FEATURE: Background DVR recording — recordings now continue independently after you close the player screen. Start up to 3 simultaneous recordings from the DVR or Guide screen and walk away.

FEATURE: TEE recording promotion — if you were watching a stream and had a simultaneous recording running, closing the player now promotes the recording to a standalone DIRECT mode instead of stopping it.

FEATURE: New 'Player Experience' settings section in Playback tab — configure Skip Interval (5/10/15/30/60s), Controls Auto-Hide Delay, Channel Zap Banner Duration, Preferred Audio Language, Controls Overlay Opacity, Keep Screen On toggle, Show Clock in Player, and Background Recording toggle.
FEATURE: New 'DVR Quick Options' in Playback settings — Default Recording Duration slider (15–180 min) and Background Recording toggle.
FEATURE: New 'Content Display' settings — Continue Watching row toggle and Thumbnail Quality (Low/Medium/High).
IMPROVEMENT: Player controls bar now supports 9 buttons: Rewind, Play/Pause, Fast Forward, Subtitles/CC, Audio Track, REC, PiP, Fullscreen, Close — all D-pad navigable.
